text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] EU (eu-west) p95 latency spike detected · economy-tier queue depth rising · impacted requests ~12% · auto-created INC-2091 · paging @infra-oncall :rotating_light:

maria: Oncall picking this up — seeing a sudden QPS bump from partner 'paystream-service' starting ~2091234500. p95 ~1.2s, errors creeping. I'm attaching a quick scrub of routing decisions.

jon: Routing logs look notable. smart-router policy 'cost-first' opened economy lane for most bursty flows; economy nodes exhausted CPU and started queueing. I can see many requests sat in the economy queue >800ms.

sahil: TL;DR: policy favored cost, but capacity for economy lane in EU wasn't autoscaled for this pattern. Two quick mitigation options: (A) raise economy pool size, (B) temporarily stop sending traffic to economy tier in EU so it fails over to standard/high.

lee: If we route to high-tier, costs will spike — want to confirm customer impact first. Any paid customers seeing errors vs slow responses?

maria: Minimal 5xx increase (~0.3% last 10m). Majority are timeouts/late responses. Affected customers (partial list): partner-payments, mobile-sync, analytics-batch (non-critical). No outage-level 5xx yet but UX bad for some endpoints.

jon: Can we do a canary: disable economy for a small slice (25%) then measure p95? If stable, expand to 100%.

sahil: Agreed. I'll prepare the policy change. Dry-run first.

maria: Assigning immediate action — sahil to run dry-run; jon to watch routing logs + p95; lee to take ownership of cost communication if needed.

sahil: Running dry-run now:
```
# dry-run: show effect of removing economy tier for eu-west
redwoodctl policy simulate --policy smart-routing-eu --remove-tier economy --duration 600
```

deploy-bot: simulate job queued (job id: sim-2091-01) — results in ~15s

deploy-bot: simulate job completed · estimated impact: p95 -> 420ms for simulated traffic slice; 25% of traffic re-routed to standard/high; estimated cost delta +18% for that slice.

jon: Simulation looks promising. Maria, shall we proceed with canary disable to 25% immediately?

maria: Yes. sahil, execute canary. Post the exact command you run.

sahil: Executing canary change (25%):
```
redwoodctl policy update --name smart-routing-eu --set "tier_weights={economy:75,standard:20,high:5}" --note "canary - shift 25% away from economy to mitigate latency spike"
```

deploy-bot: policy update accepted · change id: ch-2091-canary · started at 2091234580

jon: Monitoring... initial metrics: canary slice p95 down to 380ms, overall eu-west p95 down to 670ms. queue depth on economy reduced by ~40%.

lee: Good. Cost projection still within budget for short window. Keep an eye on partner billing-sensitive flows.

maria: Can we ramp to full (disable economy) if +10m looks stable? Options: set economy weight to 0 or create temporary override to prefer standard/high.

sahil: Preparing the full disable command. Will wait for green from jon after 10m.

(10 minutes pass)

jon: Canary stable for 10m. eu-west p95 now ~320ms, 5xx down to baseline. Suggest full disable.

sahil: Applying full override now:
```
# full override: prevent economy routing in eu-west
redwoodctl policy update --name smart-routing-eu --set "tier_weights={economy:0,standard:60,high:40}" --reason "INC-2091 mitigation - temporary disable economy in eu-west" --apply
```

deploy-bot: policy update applied · change id: ch-2091-full · rollout complete 2091234640

jon: After full disable: eu-west p50 110ms, p95 310ms. Queue depths normalized. No new errors reported.

maria: Nice work. Customer impact: degraded UX for ~12% of requests for ~20m window, now recovered. No major customer outages detected.

lee: Next steps — we should not leave economy off indefinitely. Action items: (1) increase economy pool capacity + autoscale thresholds for EU (owner: infra team), (2) adjust smart-routing policy thresholds so cost-preference doesn't route >X% to economy when queue depth >Y (owner: policies team), (3) add dashboard + alert for economy queue depth crossing 70% for >1m (owner: observability), (4) notify finance if cost delta >10% over 24h (owner: finance).

sre-lead: I'm taking ownership of post-incident follow-up. Maria, Jon, Sahil, Lee — please add short notes to INC-2091 doc with timestamps and commands used. I'll kick off a quick RCA meeting tomorrow.

maria: Quick handoff — I'm on-call for 20 more minutes, then handing to jon for overnight monitoring. Jon, please ack and track the incident doc.

jon: Acknowledged. I'll monitor for next 2 hours and keep paging if anything re-emerges.

sahil: Added patch to policy test harness to enforce 'min-queue-available' check before cost-preference moves traffic. PR: https://git.internal/r/policies/merge/432

maria: Closing note: temporary mitigation = economy tier disabled for eu-west. Full rollback planned after capacity autoscale changes and policy threshold updates. Leaving incident open for follow-up actions. :white_check_mark:

sre-lead: Thanks all — great quick coordination. I'm summarizing on the incident channel and will schedule RCA.
